chunks: Al-Sakuni narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
Two words are strange, so bear them patiently: a word of wisdom from a foolish person—accept it; and a foolish word from a wise person—forgive it.

key_terms.كَلِمَةُ حِكْمَةٍ: A saying containing wisdom and sound insight
key_terms.كَلِمَتَانِ غَرِيبَتَانِ: Two unusual or unexpected kinds of statements

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about accepting wisdom from unlikely people and forgiving mistakes from the wise?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches fairness and discernment in dealing with people’s speech. Wisdom should be accepted regardless of who says it, and a lapse from a wise person should be overlooked rather than used to reject them entirely.
